topic: Data API report filtering for frames
summary_markdown: The discussion covered two main technical points. First, confirmation was given that all clients should operate using the `clickhouse04` instance for data logging. Second, a concern was raised regarding the `data-api/v1/reports/traffic/by-frame` endpoint: it may lack proper facility ownership checks when generating reports by frame. A sample cURL request demonstrating filtering by specific facilities and demographic parameters was provided for review.
decisions: All clients should use the clickhouse04 instance.
action_items: [me] will investigate the facility ownership check within the data-api/v1/reports/traffic/by-frame endpoint.
